value: Today is a review day. That means today, we're going to play lots of reading games! Hooray, hooray!
We'll also do something brand new at the end: our very first **Fluency Check**!

value.value: Keep this playful. This review is a check-in to help you decide whether {name} is ready for Module 6 or if it would be more helpful to repeat Module 5.
First up, let's play a round of **Eagle Eyes** — small letters only!
Let's practice the heart words from this module. Read the words on the cards one at a time.
Now the big-word round! Read each big word one beat at a time.
And now . . . drum roll . . . your very first **Fluency Check**!
I'm going to time you for one minute while you read a little story. Just do your best — this is how we watch ourselves grow!

Time {name} for one minute on the next passage. Count the words read correctly and write the number down — you'll compare it at the next Fluency Check. Mistakes are fine; this is a snapshot, not a test.

text: The king and the little dog sat on the hill. Come and sing with me, said the king. They sang a long song. The song was funny, and the dog was happy. Many people came to think and drink and sing.

value.value: Here are all the books you read in Module 5.
Would you like to reread any of them?
Rereading is great practice. Encourage {name} to choose at least one book.
You finished the Module 5 review games AND your first Fluency Check. Great work!
If {name} read most words with only light prompting, they are probably ready for Module 6. If many items needed heavy support, we recommend repeating Module 5 before moving on.
